article.title: Agrin-Enriched Neonatal Spinal Cord-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Bypass Age Barriers to Organize Spinal Cord Repair

provenance.prior_observer: The earlier 2026-10-16 Observer had already identified publication/PMC and described this as novel to the lane; adding it to repo is provenance persistence, NOT discovery of a new independent paper.

verified_primary_abstract.cohorts: neonatal, adult and aged SCI mice
verified_primary_abstract.evidence: integrated multi-omics comparison; neonatal spinal-cord-derived EVs nSC-EVs; EV perturbation and enhanced adult targeting reported
proposed_mechanisms: Agrin (Agrn), enriched in nSC-EVs, involved in axon growth
endothelial cells identified as major Agrin-expressing cells
verified_primary_abstract.outcomes: adult motor and bladder functional recovery reported after targeted nSC-EV delivery
verified_primary_abstract.caveat: Results are authors' claims in published abstract; detailed controls and animal-level quantitative replay pending.

next_TOPA_actions: Acquire publisher/PMC full text and exact Supporting Information file manifest; record exact files, size, checksum and original public URLs before data extraction.
Check Data Availability Statement for actual GEO/SRA/ProteomeXchange/PRIDE accession(s), if any. Do not invent run IDs.
Map every main and supplemental figure to age, model, treatment arm, exact animal n, unit of analysis, exclusion rule, statistics and endpoint.
Verify timing of each injection relative to lesion, dose, route and need for repeated EV administration, and whether lesion/scar was established before intervention.
Verify Agrin EV fold-changes and BMS 3.2 vs 5.3 only against primary raw table or corresponding figure legend.

Test fate/EXIT specifically: cell-lineage identity, longitudinal cell occupancy, apoptosis/death, ECM synthesis cessation, deposited collagen clearance and timing; if unavailable, state M4=NO/UNKNOWN.

Only if primary source/raw data are unavailable from journal, prepare narrowly scoped author request for supplementary tables, raw behavior/histology values and sample manifest; do not send outreach automatically.
